spec_text:
---- MODULE W4Od15m0p4t5 ----
\* A stock-exchange opening auction fills a bounded position book using optimistic locking with
\* retry. A trader reads the book's current version, then commits an added position only if the
\* version is unchanged and the book still has room under its capacity bound; a successful commit
\* bumps the version. If the version has moved on, the trader retries by re-reading. A privileged
\* admin may evict a filled position. The number of filled positions never exceeds the bound.
EXTENDS Naturals, FiniteSets

Slots == {0, 1, 2}
Traders == {0, 1}
Cap == 2
MaxV == 3

VARIABLES book, version, pend, clock

vars == <<book, version, pend, clock>>

TypeOK ==
    /\ book \in SUBSET Slots
    /\ version \in 0 .. MaxV
    /\ pend \in [Traders -> [rv : 0 .. MaxV, slot : Slots, on : BOOLEAN]]
    /\ clock \in {0, 1}

Init ==
    /\ book = {}
    /\ version = 0
    /\ pend = [t \in Traders |-> [rv |-> 0, slot |-> 0, on |-> FALSE]]
    /\ clock = 0

\* Optimistically read the version and stage a position to add.
Read(t, s) ==
    /\ ~pend[t].on
    /\ pend' = [pend EXCEPT ![t] = [rv |-> version, slot |-> s, on |-> TRUE]]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<book, version, clock>>

\* Commit only if the version is unchanged and the book has room under the bound.
Commit(t) ==
    /\ pend[t].on
    /\ pend[t].rv = version
    /\ version < MaxV
    /\ pend[t].slot \notin book
    /\ Cardinality(book) < Cap
    /\ book' = book \cup {pend[t].slot}
    /\ version' = version + 1
    /\ pend' = [pend EXCEPT ![t] = [rv |-> 0, slot |-> 0, on |-> FALSE]]
    /\ UNCHANGED clock

\* The version moved on: retry by re-reading, keeping the intended slot.
Retry(t) ==
    /\ pend[t].on
    /\ pend[t].rv # version
    /\ pend' = [pend EXCEPT ![t] = [rv |-> version, slot |-> pend[t].slot, on |-> TRUE]]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<book, version, clock>>

\* Admin: evict a filled position from the book.
Evict(s) ==
    /\ s \in book
    /\ book' = book \ {s}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<version, pend, clock>>

\* Housekeeping pulse; always available.
Tick ==
    /\ clock' = 1 - clock
    /\ UNCHANGED <<book, version, pend>>

Next ==
    \/ \E t \in Traders, s \in Slots : Read(t, s)
    \/ \E t \in Traders : Commit(t) \/ Retry(t)
    \/ \E s \in Slots : Evict(s)
    \/ Tick

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

\* Bounded capacity: the number of filled positions never exceeds the bound.
WithinBookCap == Cardinality(book) <= Cap
====
nl:
A stock-exchange opening auction fills a bounded position book using optimistic locking with
retry. A trader first reads the book's current version number and stages a position it wants to
add. It commits the addition only if the version is still unchanged and the book still has room
below its capacity bound; a successful commit inserts the position and bumps the version. If the
version has moved on since the read, the trader retries by re-reading the current version while
keeping the position it intended to add. A privileged admin may evict a filled position from the
book at any time. A housekeeping pulse ticks throughout.

Actions: optimistically read the version and stage a position to add; commit the staged position
when the version is unchanged and the book has room, bumping the version; retry by re-reading
when the version has moved on; admin-evict a filled position; tick the housekeeping pulse.

SAFETY PROPERTY: the number of filled positions in the book never exceeds the capacity bound.

spec_text:
---- MODULE W4Od16m1p3t2 ----
\* A pharmacy prescription dispenser runs two instances that share one pool of dispensing bins,
\* with exclusive access governed by a ring token passed between the instances. Only the token
\* holder may allocate a free bin to a waiting prescription; allocation removes the bin from the
\* free pool and records its owner. Releasing a bin returns it to the free pool and clears its
\* owner. A bin is thus assigned to a prescription exactly when it is not in the free pool, so the
\* same bin is never handed to two prescriptions.
EXTENDS Naturals

Slots == {0, 1, 2}
Rx == {0, 1}
Inst == {"A", "B"}
NONE == 9

VARIABLES token, free, owner, pending

vars == <<token, free, owner, pending>>

TypeOK ==
    /\ token \in Inst
    /\ free \in SUBSET Slots
    /\ owner \in [Slots -> Rx \cup {NONE}]
    /\ pending \in SUBSET Rx

Init ==
    /\ token = "A"
    /\ free = Slots
    /\ owner = [s \in Slots |-> NONE]
    /\ pending = {}

\* Pass the ring token to the other instance; always available.
Pass ==
    /\ token' = IF token = "A" THEN "B" ELSE "A"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<free, owner, pending>>

\* A prescription arrives and waits for a bin.
Submit(r) ==
    /\ r \notin pending
    /\ pending' = pending \cup {r}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<token, free, owner>>

\* The token holder allocates a free bin to a waiting prescription, taking it out of the pool.
Allocate(s, r, i) ==
    /\ token = i
    /\ r \in pending
    /\ s \in free
    /\ owner[s] = NONE
    /\ free' = free \ {s}
    /\ owner' = [owner EXCEPT ![s] = r]
    /\ pending' = pending \ {r}
    /\ UNCHANGED token

\* Release a bin, returning it to the free pool and clearing its owner.
Release(s) ==
    /\ owner[s] # NONE
    /\ free' = free \cup {s}
    /\ owner' = [owner EXCEPT ![s] = NONE]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<token, pending>>

Next ==
    \/ Pass
    \/ \E r \in Rx : Submit(r)
    \/ \E s \in Slots, r \in Rx, i \in Inst : Allocate(s, r, i)
    \/ \E s \in Slots : Release(s)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

\* No double allocation: a bin is owned exactly when it is not in the free pool, so a bin can
\* never be handed out while it is still advertised as free (and thus grabbed twice).
FreeCoherent == \A s \in Slots : (owner[s] # NONE) <=> (s \notin free)
====
nl:
A pharmacy prescription dispenser runs two independent instances that share one pool of
dispensing bins, with exclusive access to the pool governed by a ring token passed back and forth
between the two instances. A prescription arrives and waits for a bin. Only the instance currently
holding the ring token may allocate a free bin to a waiting prescription; allocating removes the
bin from the free pool and records the prescription as its owner. Releasing a bin returns it to
the free pool and clears its owner. Because a bin is recorded as owned exactly when it has been
taken out of the free pool, a bin can never be handed to a second prescription while it is still
advertised as free.

Actions: pass the ring token to the other instance; submit a prescription that waits for a bin;
the token holder allocates a free bin to a waiting prescription, removing it from the pool;
release a bin, returning it to the free pool and clearing its owner.

SAFETY PROPERTY: every bin is owned by a prescription exactly when it is not in the free pool, so
the same bin is never allocated to two prescriptions at once.

---- MODULE W4Od15m1p1t0 ----
\* A stock-exchange opening auction lets only the trader holding the ring token touch the shared
\* fill counter. A holder reads the counter and stages a one-lot add against that reading, then
\* writes it back absolutely -- but passing the token discards any stage the leaving holder still
\* had, so a write always reflects the reading taken during the current, uninterrupted hold. One
\* trader may crash silently. The shared counter always equals the sum of each trader's own
\* contributions, so no committed add is ever lost by a stale write.
EXTENDS Naturals

Traders == {0, 1, 2}
N == 3
MaxTotal == 2

VARIABLES token, total, contrib, crashed, staged

vars == <<token, total, contrib, crashed, staged>>

Sum == contrib[0] + contrib[1] + contrib[2]

TypeOK ==
    /\ token \in Traders
    /\ total \in 0 .. MaxTotal
    /\ contrib \in [Traders -> 0 .. MaxTotal]
    /\ crashed \in SUBSET Traders
    /\ staged \in [Traders -> [base : 0 .. MaxTotal, on : BOOLEAN]]

Init ==
    /\ token = 0
    /\ total = 0
    /\ contrib = [t \in Traders |-> 0]
    /\ crashed = {}
    /\ staged = [t \in Traders |-> [base |-> 0, on |-> FALSE]]

\* Pass the ring token onward, discarding the leaving holder's staged write.
Pass ==
    /\ token' = (token + 1) % N
    /\ staged' = [staged EXCEPT ![token] = [base |-> 0, on |-> FALSE]]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<total, contrib, crashed>>

\* The token holder reads the counter and stages a one-lot add against that reading.
Read(t) ==
    /\ t = token
    /\ t \notin crashed
    /\ ~staged[t].on
    /\ total < MaxTotal
    /\ staged' = [staged EXCEPT ![t] = [base |-> total, on |-> TRUE]]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<token, total, contrib, crashed>>

\* The holder writes its staged add back absolutely and records its own contribution.
Write(t) ==
    /\ t = token
    /\ staged[t].on
    /\ total' = staged[t].base + 1
    /\ contrib' = [contrib EXCEPT ![t] = contrib[t] + 1]
    /\ staged' = [staged EXCEPT ![t] = [base |-> 0, on |-> FALSE]]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<token, crashed>>

\* One trader may crash silently, dropping any staged write.
Crash(t) ==
    /\ crashed = {}
    /\ crashed' = {t}
    /\ staged' = [staged EXCEPT ![t] = [base |-> 0, on |-> FALSE]]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<token, total, contrib>>

Next ==
    \/ Pass
    \/ \E t \in Traders : Read(t) \/ Write(t) \/ Crash(t)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

\* No lost updates: the shared counter equals the sum of every trader's own contributions.
NoLostAdd == total = Sum
====
nl:
A stock-exchange opening auction lets only the trader currently holding the ring token touch the
shared fill counter. A holder reads the counter and stages a one-lot add computed from that
reading, then writes the new value back absolutely. Passing the ring token onward discards any
staged write the leaving holder still had, so a write always reflects the reading the holder took
during its current, uninterrupted hold of the token. One trader may crash silently, dropping any
staged write it had. Each trader also keeps a tally of its own contributions. Because only the
token holder writes and a stage cannot survive a token pass, no add based on a stale reading can
overwrite the counter, and no committed add is lost.

Actions: pass the ring token onward, discarding the leaving holder's staged write; the token
holder reads the counter and stages a one-lot add; the holder writes its staged add back
absolutely and records its own contribution; one trader crashes silently, dropping its stage.

SAFETY PROPERTY: the shared fill counter always equals the sum of every trader's own recorded
contributions, so no committed add is ever lost by a stale write.

---- MODULE W4Od12m8p4t1 ----
\* A blood-bank inventory tracker guards its fridges with hierarchical locks: a coarse fridge
\* lock and a fine per-shelf lock. Storing a unit onto a shelf requires holding both the fridge
\* lock and that shelf's lock, and is only allowed while the shelf is below its capacity bound.
\* Store orders arrive in an inbox and may be honoured out of order. Units may also be withdrawn.
\* No shelf ever holds more units than its capacity bound.
EXTENDS Naturals

Shelves == {0, 1}
Workers == {0, 1}
FREE == 9
Cap == 2

VARIABLES fridgeLock, shelfLock, stored, inbox, clock

vars == <<fridgeLock, shelfLock, stored, inbox, clock>>

TypeOK ==
    /\ fridgeLock \in Workers \cup {FREE}
    /\ shelfLock \in [Shelves -> Workers \cup {FREE}]
    /\ stored \in [Shelves -> 0 .. Cap]
    /\ inbox \in SUBSET Shelves
    /\ clock \in {0, 1}

Init ==
    /\ fridgeLock = FREE
    /\ shelfLock = [s \in Shelves |-> FREE]
    /\ stored = [s \in Shelves |-> 0]
    /\ inbox = {}
    /\ clock = 0

\* A store order for a shelf arrives in the inbox (may be honoured out of order later).
Request(s) ==
    /\ s \notin inbox
    /\ inbox' = inbox \cup {s}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<fridgeLock, shelfLock, stored, clock>>

\* Grab the coarse fridge lock.
GrabFridge(w) ==
    /\ fridgeLock = FREE
    /\ fridgeLock' = w
    /\ UNCHANGED <<shelfLock, stored, inbox, clock>>

\* Grab a shelf's fine lock while holding the fridge lock.
GrabShelf(s, w) ==
    /\ fridgeLock = w
    /\ shelfLock[s] = FREE
    /\ shelfLock' = [shelfLock EXCEPT ![s] = w]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<fridgeLock, stored, inbox, clock>>

\* Store a unit onto a shelf, holding both locks and below the shelf's capacity bound.
Store(s, w) ==
    /\ fridgeLock = w
    /\ shelfLock[s] = w
    /\ s \in inbox
    /\ stored[s] < Cap
    /\ stored' = [stored EXCEPT ![s] = stored[s] + 1]
    /\ inbox' = inbox \ {s}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<fridgeLock, shelfLock, clock>>

\* Withdraw a unit from a shelf.
Withdraw(s) ==
    /\ stored[s] > 0
    /\ stored' = [stored EXCEPT ![s] = stored[s] - 1]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<fridgeLock, shelfLock, inbox, clock>>

\* Release a shelf lock.
ReleaseShelf(s, w) ==
    /\ shelfLock[s] = w
    /\ shelfLock' = [shelfLock EXCEPT ![s] = FREE]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<fridgeLock, stored, inbox, clock>>

\* Release the fridge lock once no shelf is still locked by this worker.
ReleaseFridge(w) ==
    /\ fridgeLock = w
    /\ \A s \in Shelves : shelfLock[s] # w
    /\ fridgeLock' = FREE
    /\ UNCHANGED <<shelfLock, stored, inbox, clock>>

\* Housekeeping pulse; always available.
Tick ==
    /\ clock' = 1 - clock
    /\ UNCHANGED <<fridgeLock, shelfLock, stored, inbox>>

Next ==
    \/ \E s \in Shelves : Request(s) \/ Withdraw(s)
    \/ \E w \in Workers : GrabFridge(w) \/ ReleaseFridge(w)
    \/ \E s \in Shelves, w \in Workers : GrabShelf(s, w) \/ Store(s, w) \/ ReleaseShelf(s, w)
    \/ Tick

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

\* Bounded capacity: no shelf ever holds more units than its capacity bound.
WithinShelfCap == \A s \in Shelves : stored[s] <= Cap
====
nl:
A blood-bank inventory tracker guards its fridges with two levels of hierarchical locks: a coarse
lock over a fridge and a fine lock over each shelf. To store a unit onto a shelf, a worker must
hold both the fridge lock and that shelf's lock, and the store is allowed only while the shelf is
below its capacity bound. Store orders arrive in an inbox and may be honoured out of order, so the
order in which shelves are stocked need not match the order the orders came in. Units may also be
withdrawn from a shelf. A worker cannot release a fridge lock while it still holds any shelf lock
inside that fridge. A housekeeping pulse ticks throughout.

Actions: a store order for a shelf arrives in the inbox; grab the coarse fridge lock; grab a
shelf's fine lock while holding the fridge lock; store a unit onto a shelf while holding both locks
and below capacity, consuming its order; withdraw a unit from a shelf; release a shelf lock;
release the fridge lock once no shelf is still locked by the worker; tick the housekeeping pulse.

SAFETY PROPERTY: no shelf ever holds more units than its capacity bound.

spec_text:
---- MODULE W4Od15m3p2t4 ----
\* A stock-exchange opening auction, coordinated by an elected leader (with failover to a new
\* term), keeps a fixed quantity of shares distributed across three books: available, locked, and
\* executed. The leader locks available shares for matching -- bounded by a runtime-adjustable
\* capacity -- executes locked shares, or unlocks them back to available. Shares are conserved:
\* the three books always sum to the fixed total, no share created or destroyed.
EXTENDS Naturals

Total == 3
MaxTerm == 1
MaxCap == 3

VARIABLES avail, locked, executed, capacity, term

vars == <<avail, locked, executed, capacity, term>>

TypeOK ==
    /\ avail \in 0 .. Total
    /\ locked \in 0 .. Total
    /\ executed \in 0 .. Total
    /\ capacity \in 0 .. MaxCap
    /\ term \in 0 .. MaxTerm

Init ==
    /\ avail = Total
    /\ locked = 0
    /\ executed = 0
    /\ capacity = MaxCap
    /\ term = 0

\* Failover: elect a fresh leader term, cycling within a bounded band.
Elect ==
    /\ term' = (term + 1) % (MaxTerm + 1)
    /\ UNCHANGED <<avail, locked, executed, capacity>>

\* Lock available shares for matching, staying within the current capacity.
Lock(k) ==
    /\ k > 0
    /\ k <= avail
    /\ locked + k <= capacity
    /\ avail' = avail - k
    /\ locked' = locked + k
    /\ UNCHANGED <<executed, capacity, term>>

\* Execute locked shares, moving them to the executed book.
Execute(k) ==
    /\ k > 0
    /\ k <= locked
    /\ locked' = locked - k
    /\ executed' = executed + k
    /\ UNCHANGED <<avail, capacity, term>>

\* Unlock shares back to the available book.
Unlock(k) ==
    /\ k > 0
    /\ k <= locked
    /\ locked' = locked - k
    /\ avail' = avail + k
    /\ UNCHANGED <<executed, capacity, term>>

\* Capacity changes at runtime to a different value; always available.
Resize(c) ==
    /\ c # capacity
    /\ capacity' = c
    /\ UNCHANGED <<avail, locked, executed, term>>

Next ==
    \/ Elect
    \/ \E k \in 1 .. Total : Lock(k) \/ Execute(k) \/ Unlock(k)
    \/ \E c \in 0 .. MaxCap : Resize(c)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

\* Conservation: available, locked, and executed shares always sum to the fixed total.
SharesConserved == avail + locked + executed = Total
====
nl:
A stock-exchange opening auction is coordinated by an elected leader that fails over to a fresh
term when needed. It keeps a fixed quantity of shares distributed across three books: available,
locked, and executed. The leader locks available shares for matching, but only so far as the
locked total stays within a capacity that can be adjusted at runtime. Locked shares may then be
executed, moving them into the executed book, or unlocked, moving them back to available. The
capacity may be resized at runtime to a different value. No share is ever created or destroyed.

Actions: fail over by electing a fresh leader term; lock available shares for matching while
within capacity; execute locked shares into the executed book; unlock locked shares back to
available; resize the matching capacity at runtime.

SAFETY PROPERTY: the available, locked, and executed share counts always sum to the fixed total,
so no share is ever created or destroyed.

spec_text:
---- MODULE W4Od13m1p1t5 ----
\* A vending-machine network shares one mechanical vend meter, writable only by the machine
\* holding the ring token. A holder reads the meter and later writes it back as the read value
\* plus one, logging the vend. Passing the token discards any read the leaving holder still had,
\* so a write reflects the meter as read during the current, uninterrupted hold. A privileged
\* admin may override, clearing all outstanding reads. The meter always equals the number of
\* vends recorded in the log, so no vend is lost by a stale write.
EXTENDS Naturals, Sequences

Machines == {0, 1}
N == 2
MaxVends == 3

VARIABLES token, meter, vendLog, staged

vars == <<token, meter, vendLog, staged>>

TypeOK ==
    /\ token \in Machines
    /\ meter \in 0 .. MaxVends
    /\ vendLog \in Seq(Machines)
    /\ staged \in [Machines -> [rm : 0 .. MaxVends, on : BOOLEAN]]

Init ==
    /\ token = 0
    /\ meter = 0
    /\ vendLog = <<>>
    /\ staged = [m \in Machines |-> [rm |-> 0, on |-> FALSE]]

\* Pass the ring token, discarding the leaving holder's staged read.
Pass ==
    /\ token' = (token + 1) % N
    /\ staged' = [staged EXCEPT ![token] = [rm |-> 0, on |-> FALSE]]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<meter, vendLog>>

\* The token holder reads the current meter value.
Read(m) ==
    /\ m = token
    /\ ~staged[m].on
    /\ meter < MaxVends
    /\ staged' = [staged EXCEPT ![m] = [rm |-> meter, on |-> TRUE]]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<token, meter, vendLog>>

\* The holder writes the meter back as its read value plus one, logging the vend.
Vend(m) ==
    /\ m = token
    /\ staged[m].on
    /\ Len(vendLog) < MaxVends
    /\ meter' = staged[m].rm + 1
    /\ vendLog' = Append(vendLog, m)
    /\ staged' = [staged EXCEPT ![m] = [rm |-> 0, on |-> FALSE]]
    /\ UNCHANGED token

\* Admin override: clear all outstanding reads; always available.
Override ==
    /\ staged' = [m \in Machines |-> [rm |-> 0, on |-> FALSE]]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<token, meter, vendLog>>

Next ==
    \/ Pass
    \/ \E m \in Machines : Read(m) \/ Vend(m)
    \/ Override

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

\* No lost updates: the meter equals the number of vends recorded in the log.
NoLostVend == meter = Len(vendLog)
====
nl:
A vending-machine network shares a single mechanical vend meter, which may be written only by the
machine currently holding the ring token. A holder first reads the current meter value. Later it
writes the meter back as the value it read plus one, and logs the vend. Passing the ring token
onward discards any read the leaving holder still had outstanding, so a write always reflects the
meter value as it was read during the holder's current, uninterrupted hold of the token. A
privileged admin may override at any time, clearing all outstanding reads. Because a stale read
cannot survive a token pass, no vend based on an out-of-date meter reading can overwrite the meter
and lose a vend.

Actions: pass the ring token, discarding the leaving holder's staged read; the token holder reads
the current meter; the holder writes the meter back as its read value plus one and logs the vend;
admin-override to clear all outstanding reads.

SAFETY PROPERTY: the vend meter always equals the number of vends recorded in the log, so no vend
is ever lost by a stale write.
